description: The chart represents the distribution of different stimuli types, showing the proportion of each category. The chart is divided into six slices, labeled as "External News Article", "Intra-agency news article", "Press Release", "Interview", "Email", and "Draft/Other", colored in green, orange, yellow, navy blue, maroon red, and dark red, respectively. The proportions are approximately 39.5% for "External News Article" (green), 2.6% for "Intra-agency news article" (orange), 10.5% for "Press Release" (yellow), 5.3% for "Interview" (navy blue), 13.2% for "Email" (maroon red), and 23.7% for "Draft/Other" (dark red). The labels are placed outside the chart, adjacent to their corresponding slices, and include the count and total number of observations (e.g., "15/38" for "External News Article"). The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with "External News Article" being the largest slice, followed by "Draft/Other", "Email", "Press Release", "Interview", and "Intra-agency news article". The chart does not include a legend, but the labels and colors are used to distinguish between the categories.
